messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp needs final acceptance by Friday. Procurement prefers CC payment (expedite), but legal is flagging that the SOW requires a wet signature. If we don’t align, enablement/onboarding will slip to next sprint.

jordan_sales: Do we have clarity on the term? They asked for 9 months instead of 12 during the call. That affects pro-rate and billing cadence.

sam_rev_ops: How much is outstanding on the first invoice if we do 9mo? Also need to know billing entity for the invoice.

maria_cs: Numbers from finance: annual list $45,000. Pro-rate for 9mo = $33,750. Invoice meta: 
```
INV: INV-AC-0916
Amount: $33,750
Billing entity: AcmeCorp US, tax id on file
```

maria_cs: Procurement said they can put on a corporate card today if we accept CC. Legal says they can’t onboard without a signed SOW (wet sig) for this customer due to their audit controls.

lee_legal: Need to see the exact SOW clause. Who's the signer on their side? Also confirm if we can accept payment as an interim trigger in our T&Cs — we may need an amendment that says payment triggers provisioning but full contract signature remains required.

jordan_sales: Point of contact is Aaron M. on procurement, he confirmed card payment. Aaron said legal will route signer but could be 7–10 business days.

anya_enable: From enablement — we can start onboarding work (kickoff training scheduling + workspace prep) after payment posts, but we won’t provision dedicated capacity or transfer data until contract is countersigned. Need to confirm what 'start' means here.

ops_bot: billing-system: Invoice INV-AC-0916 created and pending payment (link: https://billing.example/inv/INV-AC-0916) :page_facing_up:

sam_rev_ops: Proposed path: accept CC to avoid delay on enablement scheduling, issue invoice INV-AC-0916, and create a short amendment to the SOW: "Payment triggers onboarding activities; signed SOW required within 30 days or invoice subject to hold." Legal to draft. Does that work?

lee_legal: We can draft a 30-day amendment but need explicit signatory names + clause for default. I can prepare a one-paragraph amendment and add the sign-off section.

jordan_sales: We should also confirm there’s no discount change for 9mo. Client asked about prorate only — they didn't ask for a % discount.

maria_cs: Confirmed: pricing remains prorated only; no additional discount. Aaron expects invoice today if we accept CC.

anya_enable: OK — enablement will run pre-provisioning tasks upon payment clear (workspace setup, invite lists, training scheduling). We'll hold off on data migration until signed SOW is in our system.

sam_rev_ops: Action items: 
- @lee_legal draft 30-day amendment and return by EOD tomorrow
- @maria_cs confirm signer name and email (Aaron said he'd loop legal)
- @jordan_sales confirm client agrees to prorate only
- Finance to process CC once provided

maria_cs: I’ll take point. Aaron offered the CC details via secure form. I'll push legal contact and ask for signer info now.

lee_legal: I'll draft the amendment and put it in Docusign with a sticky note that onboarding begins after payment posts. Will CC Contracts for records.

jordan_sales: I’ll confirm the 9mo pro-rate wording with Aaron and reply here.

maria_cs: Thanks — if we get payment today, enablement will begin scheduling this week. I’ll update the thread after I get the signer name. :thumbsup:
